generation.goal: Learn how to draw a palm tree easily

mainForms: A single curving trunk that leans slightly right and swells at the base
A crown of long fronds radiating from one point at the top of the trunk
A cluster of oval coconuts hanging at the top of the trunk
A low patch of sand at the base of the trunk
importantDetails: Ring bands running across the trunk
Feathery leaflet pairs along each frond spine, drawn as short strokes off the main line
Five or six separate coconuts, each with a small highlight line
Short tufts of grass where the trunk meets the sand
Pebble marks scattered on the sand
analysis.drawingStrategy: Start with the long curving trunk and its ring bands, then mark the crown point and build the fronds one at a time as a spine with paired leaflets. Finish with the coconut cluster and the sand at the base, so the tree stands on something.
